register_agent: register a custom agent class in the ParlAI agent registry using the register_agent decorator
register_teacher: register a custom teacher class in the ParlAI teacher registry using the register_teacher decorator
load_agent_module: load an agent class from a shorthand or full module path string like seq2seq
load_teacher_module: load a teacher class from a task name string like babi or babi:task10k
load_world_module: load a world class for a task environment like InteractiveWorld or DefaultWorld
